title: No correction by tab "Treatments"
body:
After the last update of 3.1.0.3-dev-a I noticed an error:
So far I have been able to correct an incorrect entry of the bolus using the "Treatments" button. Unfortunately, I can no longer activate the delete function.

comments.body:
On small phones, it is hidden in the menu. For larger phones, a trashcan icon is shown.
 - Click on the three dots on the right,
 - Click on delete
 - Select the items you like to delete, with the checkboxes
 - Click the delete button
 - Click to confirm the deletion

This was implemented in https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/1362

Thank you so much for your answer.  unfortunately your suggestion doesn't work.  I could do the same with the old version.  am the only one with this error?  will download the apk to my old phone today.  let's see if it works there.
